bio.title: I'm
paragraphs: A results-driven Multi-Platform Engineer specializing in Mobile, Desktop, and Web ecosystems. I bridge the gap between high-performance hardware and seamless user experiences using Kotlin Multiplatform.

My vision is centered on Connectivity—building systems that work everywhere, for everyone. From custom Android POS drivers to scalable Nuxt applications, I craft solutions that are as robust as they are intuitive.

skills.name: Android (Kotlin)
skills.longDescription: Building enterprise-grade mobile systems using modern Android SDK features. Specialized in clean-architecture layouts, background scheduling, hardware driver communication (USB, Bluetooth, Serial), and local databases.

skills.name: KMP / CMP
skills.longDescription: Sharing application logic and user interfaces seamlessly between Android, iOS, and Desktop platforms. Reducing development times by sharing up to 85% of code while preserving native UX standards.

skills.name: Nuxt / Vue
skills.longDescription: Developing premium, SEO-optimized, and lightning-fast web applications. Implementing glassmorphic user interfaces, fluid micro-interactions, responsive grids, and static generation builds for static hosting.

skills.name: Spring Boot
skills.longDescription: Designing robust, microservices back-ends, securing APIs with JWT, managing database transactional integrity, and structuring high-throughput sockets.

skills.name: PostgreSQL
skills.longDescription: Relational schema design, writing complex SQL queries, index optimization, structuring stored procedures, and ensuring read/write transaction isolation.

skills.name: Clean Architecture
skills.longDescription: Adhering to strict SOLID design principles, decoupling business logic from external frameworks, separating code into Data, Domain, and Presentation layers, and ensuring testability.

experience.description: Leading technical strategy for complex POS implementations and maintaining mission-critical Kotlin libraries for thermal printing technologies.
achievements: Designed, implemented, and maintained the Printer-ESC-POS library with 100+ forks and active application integrations.
Architected enterprise-grade cross-platform POS systems, reducing syncing latency by 45%.
Configured custom microservice APIs on Spring Boot, managing secure OAuth2 flows and webhooks integrations.

experience.description: Focused on low-level hardware integration and building high-performance mobile applications with real-time data synchronization.
achievements: Programmed local hardware serial interface communication drivers for peripheral payment systems.
Spearheaded Room database offline synchronization mechanisms using conflict-free timestamp synchronization.
Integrated custom Android system alerts, background services, and customized OEM battery scheduling setups.

experience.description: Developed interactive and high-conversion web platforms using modern JavaScript frameworks and responsive design principles.
achievements: Coded responsive layout landing pages with 95+ Google Lighthouse speed and SEO scores.
Created fluid CSS micro-animations, custom interactive scrollbars, and image filters.
Integrated complex payment checkout pages (Stripe, Paypal) with Vue.js modules.
